snippet.title: The Slormancer - Content Trailer - From 0.1 to 1.0
snippet.description:
The Slormancer is leaving Early Access on May 13, 2025
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104280/The_Slormancer/
Buy on GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/the_slormancer

The Slormancer is an epic 2D Action-RPG Dungeon Crawling game following a band of outcasts on their fight against hordes of enemies lead by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past!

And if you want to follow our progress, you can find us here:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/tkYxSuB
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Slormancer/

Thank you for watching!
